cases.input: A Python static checker flags duplicate methods but misses a class assignment replaced by a same-name method.
cases.reason: Matches the reported asymmetric redefinition symptom; current owner compatibility still requires probing.

cases.input: A user reports that a name is shadowed but does not identify whether it is an assignment, definition, import, or inherited attribute.
cases.reason: Establish binding kinds and scope before applying this narrowly sourced repair.

cases.input: A user wants every sequential assignment to a variable to produce an error.
cases.reason: Ordinary assignment-to-assignment rebinding is outside the repair and must remain preserved.

cases.input: A runtime descriptor inherited from a base class is hidden by a subclass attribute.
cases.reason: This is not the supplied static definition-over-assignment binding problem.
